capabilities: add and remove dividers in the ribbon via settings
drag dividers within the ribbon to position them
customize divider appearance with CSS using per-divider classes
work around the ribbon icon-order bug with CSS snippets
extras: The README ends with a tip link but provides no documentation of plugin limitations beyond the icon-order bug workaround.
problem: Obsidian's ribbon offers no built-in way to space or group plugin icons, and an icon-order bug can rearrange icons when plugins are toggled or updated.
summary: Ribbon customization plugin that adds draggable divider elements to the ribbon to space out and group icons.
